hints.title: Relative Distance Geometry
hints.text: Sort the stone coordinates so that x < y < z. The spaces between stones determine how many moves are required to make them consecutive.

hints.title: Minimum Moves Cases
hints.text: If z - x is 2, the stones are already consecutive (0 moves). If either adjacent gap is at most 2, a single move suffices (1 move). Otherwise, 2 moves are always enough.

hints.title: Maximum Moves Sum
hints.text: To maximize moves, step inward by single increments. Each available empty slot between endpoints is used, giving (z - y - 1) + (y - x - 1) total maximum moves.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating game tree transitions wastes time when the solution is governed by closed-form geometry.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorting 3 numbers and evaluating simple arithmetic expressions takes constant time and memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should identify the 0, 1, and 2 move cases for minimum moves and gap arithmetic for maximum.
complexity.notes: Maximum moves is simply total internal spaces (z - x - 2).
